**Authors:** Hyung Won Chung, Le Hou, Shayne Longpre, Barret Zoph, Yifei Tang, William Fedus, Eric Li, et al.

## Abstract

We introduce LLaMA a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters.
